description: Roll sealed dice freight through nonperiodic moving apertures while maintaining its labelled 3D orientation.
name: Blind Dice Courier V2 · Difficulty 2 · Full Interaction
natural_language: Roll the die through the single sliding face gate to the dock. Match the marked top face on arrival. Faces remain visible. One press rolls one square in 0.6 seconds. Keep the whole tipping die inside the opening until it clears. Shutter contact, a wrong face, or an incomplete submission ends the episode. The sweep rail shows current and upcoming turns. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console, debugger, inspector, network, source, DOM or page-state inspection, terminal, shell, Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload, navigation, browser extensions, external applications, or any other implementation or hidden-state access. Do not switch to or interact with pre-existing, unrelated, blank, or browser-settings tabs. Tabs opened by visible task controls are allowed only if they are part of this task, using their visible controls only.
